current_f32_rank_two_algorithm: One output thread scans each candidate and all other values to find its desired stable rank, repeating the same comparisons for each output; worst work grows with k and the square of the axis length.
current_bf16_algorithm: Uses a cooperative row block for axes of at least 32, selecting one rank at a time with lower-index ties.
candidate: Compute each candidate stable rank once in parallel per row, then scatter candidates with rank < k to their unique output positions. Use runtime rank, dimensions, strides, offsets, axis, k and largest/smallest; preserve or explicitly handle NaN semantics.
peer_cost_caveat: PyTorch peer uses full stable sort then narrow for every input, including the cost of full sorting; it is not native torch.topk timing.
